pages.title: Eternal Totem
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 1 Totem of Undying, 4 Gold Ingots and 4 Diamonds.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active only while held in the main hand or off hand: when you take fatal damage, the death is negated and your health is fully restored, followed by 1 minute of Regeneration V, Absorption V and Resistance V; each trigger consumes 1 durability (20 total). The totem shatters once its durability runs out.$(br2)§lSynergy: §r Healing is based on your current max health, so while a Life Star is equipped (max health 50) you are restored to the full 50 points.
The grid above shows the layout: totem of undying in the center, gold ingots in the corners, diamonds on the edges.
